ar.active: Mix compiles one application from service, config/7, pcakage/locker13 and pinia/old13.
Actual validator is 1.ex, projector is 2.ex/old.ex, checkpoint module is cache.ex.
Filename/class names differ: cache.ex defines Locker.Common/Data; old.ex defines Common2; receipt.ex is a session actor.
config/7 contains compiled Elixir application input handling; service/config contains real runtime settings.
Common2.run invokes six finite continuation stages, including checkpoint recovery, positional conversion, event fold, snapshot projection and digest.
Every checkpoint canonicalizes the derived state JSON, encodes that JSON as a JSON string, quotes it as one CSV cell, then actually decodes both layers during recovery.
Stage2 uses [version,events,state] while ledger rows use [sequence,uuid,sha256]; outside and domain events use keyed objects.
Complete processing reports status=complete and errorMessage empty; rejection reports status=rejected and successReason. Consumers use status/HTTP status, never the misleading field name.
POST /stock.php executes the Phoenix controller rather than PHP.
Events are internally reversed, then sorted by sequence/id. Replayed identifiers collapse, conflicting identifiers reject atomically; late histories reorder and explicit gaps remain incomplete.
The extra reverse before stable sequence sort runs on every bounded event batch.
A versioned CSV/JSON-string checkpoint adapter restores canonical state before the current projection pipeline.
The fixed role map connects stock.php, InvoiceBuilder, Receipt, Locker and stock:<session> names to one real protocol.
